messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Serbian (Latin script), guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Serbian (Latin script) line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Alignment Table (Serbian Latin script)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition (from Step 1) | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation (EN) | Status | |-------------|--------------------------------------|----------------------|------------------------|--------| | Ed | Discourse marker “And” | **I** | and | OK | | ecco | Exclamatory pointer “lo!” | **evo** | lo! / behold | OK | | quasi | Degree adverb “almost” | **gotovo** | almost | OK | | al | Prepositional determiner “at the” | **na** | at the | OK | | cominciar | Noun “beginning” (of the steep) | **početku** | beginning | OK | | de | Preposition “of” (genitive) | **strme** *(genitive adjective)* | of the steep | **UNNECESSARY** (genitive expressed by the noun “staze”) | | l'erta | Nominal complement “the steep” (path) | **staze** | (the) steep road | OK | | una | Indefinite article “a” | **jedna** | a | OK | | lonza | She‑leopard | **leopardska ženka** | she‑leopard (female) | OK | | leggera | Adjective “light” | **lagana** | light | OK | | e | Coordinating conjunction “and” | **i** | and | OK | | presta | Adjective “nimble” | **okretna** | nimble | OK | | molto | Degree adverb “very” | **veoma** | very | OK | | che | Relative pronoun “which” | **koja** | which | OK | | di | Preposition “with” (instrument) | **sa** | with | OK | | pel | Noun “coat / fur” | **dlakom** | coat/fur (instrumental) | OK | | macolato | Attribute “spotted” | **tačkama** | spotted (by spots) | OK | | era | Copular verb “was” (imperf.) | **je bila** | was | OK | | coverta | Passive participle “covered” | **prekrivena** | covered | OK |
---
### Items Requiring Attention - **UNNECESSARY:** *de* – the genitive relationship is conveyed in Serbian by the noun “staze” (steep road) without a separate preposition. All other source tokens are accounted for with appropriate Serbian equivalents.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Serbian (Latin script) script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Serbian (Latin script) text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 31: - Original: I evo, gotovo na početku strme staze, - Issue: none - Corrected: I evo, gotovo na početku strme staze,
- Line 32: - Original: jedna lagana i veoma okretna leopardska ženka, - Issue: none - Corrected: jedna lagana i veoma okretna leopardska ženka,
- Line 33: - Original: koja je bila prekrivena dlakom sa tačkama; - Issue: none - Corrected: koja je bila prekrivena dlakom sa tačkama;
``` I evo, gotovo na početku strme staze, jedna lagana i veoma okretna leopardska ženka, koja je bila prekrivena dlakom sa tačkama; ```
